combine_naive_enn: combine a base ENN and head ENN naively into a single EpistemicNetwork without optimization
make_optimized_forward: create an optimized JIT-compiled forward function that combines base and head ENNs for batched sampling
review_combine_naive_enn: review the combine_naive_enn function to understand how it chains base and head ENN forward passes
review_make_optimized_forward: review the make_optimized_forward function to understand how it uses vmap and jit for batched ENN sampling
test_combine_naive_enn: test the combine_naive_enn function by passing a head ENN and base ENN and verifying the combined output
